meta.title: dsh-info-check
meta.description: Adds four confirmation dialogs around substantive work: intent, one plan, per-milestone acceptance, and delivery. Settings control milestones, expectation, timer, and ledger. Use the Info checker switch next to the agent preset; decisions go to .dsh-info-check/ledger.md. No network. When off, the conversation gets no dialogs and no policy section.
